name_reason: Already compliant: fd2_ prefix, descriptor accurately reflects the operation (one slide-in step of the wide 'main' 0xAA-byte panel entering from the right). Matches the sibling naming scheme fd2_slide_panel_step_<dir>_<size> (left_main / top_small / bottom_main / bottom_small). No Ghidra address residue.
purpose: Render one INTRO (slide-in) frame of the Party Status Overview wide main panel entering from the right edge; right-edge mirror of fd2_slide_panel_step_left_main.
logic_summary: row_bytes=0xAA. If frame_idx>4 the panel is stationary (dst_x=0x4B). Else x_shift=(4-frame_idx)*0x32; dst_x=x_shift+0x4B (descends 0xF5->0x4B over frames 0..4); while the panel right edge (x_shift+0xF5) exceeds screen width 0x140 the copy is right-clipped via row_bytes=0x140-dst_x. The source pointer always starts at row-0 offset 0x2E8B (= src x 0x4B + 0xAA, the panel's right portion) and never advances, because the right edge clips by shrinking width only (unlike left_main which advances src_x on left clip). Then copies 0x75 (117) rows of row_bytes bytes from src_buffer+0x2E8B into data_fd2_large_game_state_buffer_ptr+(dst_x+0x2E40), advancing both pointers by 0x140 (320 stride) per row.

params.name: src_buffer
params.semantics: Base address of the composed panel buffer (the malloc'd panel_buf filled by fd2_render_party_status_overview_content); source rows are read from src_buffer+0x2E8B onward.
params.reason: Accurately names the source panel buffer base; no address residue.

params.name: frame_idx
params.semantics: 0-based slide animation frame index; caller (intro loop) drives it 0->0xB. Frames 0..4 slide the panel in from the right (right-clipped while off-screen); frames >=5 hold it stationary at dst x 0x4B.
params.reason: Accurately names the animation frame index; no address residue.

returns.semantics: No return value; output is written into the mode-13h workspace mirror (data_fd2_large_game_state_buffer_ptr).

comment_original_issue: Original src comment was a single line ('Right panel slide-in (mirror of left_main).'), accurate but thin: it under-documented the INTRO-vs-OUTRO role split (this is the slide-in driver; left_main is the slide-out), the fixed source offset 0x2E8B, and the right-only width clipping (no src advance, unlike left_main).
notes: Disassembly cross-checked against source: branch order (CMP/JLE) and arithmetic (EAX=(4-frame_idx)*0x32, EBX=dst_x, EBP=row_bytes clip, EDI src +0x2E8B, EBX dst +0x2E40, loop 0..0x75 step 0x140) match exactly; memmove target global [0x00053a49] = data_fd2_large_game_state_buffer_ptr. No hidden EAX folding. The decompiler 'param_2 < 5' and the source 'frame_idx > 4 else' are equivalent. Ghidra plate already accurate and consistent with refined understanding, so left untouched.
